title: Fractal Edge Roughness
desc: Judge contour roughness and high-frequency noise variance by matching the Hurst exponent (H).
hint: Adjust the lower curve's roughness (Hurst H) to match the upper target edge texture.

roughnessBias.title: {{title}} · Roughness Perception Bias
roughnessBias.subTitle: Systematic perception offset between observed and physical Hurst roughness
roughnessBias.desc: A positive bias indicates you tend to perceive edges as smoother than they are, while a negative bias indicates hypersensitivity to high-frequency jitter.

bandSensitivity.title: {{title}} · Roughness Band Diagnostics
bandSensitivity.subTitle: Perceptual accuracy across high, medium, and low frequency roughness spectrums
bandSensitivity.needMoreTrials: Complete at least 3 trials in each roughness band to generate blindspot diagnostics.
